custodian.name: Government of Assam, Revenue and Disaster Management / Directorate of Land Records; Bongaigaon district administration
custodian.localEvidence: The district ILRMS page states that Bongaigaon has five circles and that three were covered under ILRMS; the official Bhunaksha service returned Bongaigaon district, circle, village and parcel responses. This is local district/circle service evidence, not merely national agency prose.

queries.outcome: Official Assam service was found; returned service labels include Assamese Bongaigaon district, circle and village names.

routeAttempts.outcome: HTTP 200; public React viewer loaded and referenced its current JavaScript bundle.

HTTP 200; current bundle exposed public backend base https://bhunaksha.assam.gov.in/bhunakshaBackEnd and routes /proxy/districts, /proxy/circles, /proxy/villages, /proxy/getAllDagsFromDharitree and /proxy/parcel_info.
HTTP 200; district code 13 returned as Bongaigaon (Assamese label plus English transliteration).
HTTP 200; returned Bongaigaon Revenue Circle code 130101 and other district circles.
HTTP 200; returned Bongaigaon Town Part 1-8 and surrounding villages; Bongaigaon Town Part 1 code 130101010120001.

HTTP 200; returned a bounded DAG list with DAG numbers and non-sensitive land area/class fields. Native source fields observed: dag_no, patta_number, dag_area_bigha, dag_area_katha, dag_area_lessa, dag_area_gonda, dag_area_kranti, patta_type, land_class.
HTTP 200; returned one geometry with id, locationCode, uniqueId and WKT MULTIPOLYGON in EPSG:32646. Repeat bounded requests for DAG 2 and 3 also returned HTTP 200 geometries.
Route identified from the public viewer JavaScript as a PDF trace-map action; not called because a PDF is not needed for safe parcel qualification.

schemaAndCrs.sourceCrs: EPSG:32646 (UTM zone 46N), supplied as crs request and dataProjection in current viewer JS
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: parcel_info response exposes id (UUID), uniqueId and locationCode; DAG number is the land-record identity used by the request. Retained sample omitted, so no identity was copied into GeoJSON.
schemaAndCrs.viewerEvidence: Current bundle reads parcel geometry using EPSG:32646 and renders it to EPSG:3857.

safeFieldAllowlist: native parcel id or stable uniqueId
DAG number only as source identity/provenance
scopeLimits: The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted; no exact-point hit test was used.
A few sampled DAG geometries from Bongaigaon Town Part 1 establish an operational public geometry route, not citywide completeness.
The district page reports only three of five circles covered under ILRMS, while current Bhunaksha returned public village/DAG data; coverage and freshness remain bounded uncertainties.
No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception was used.
No GeoJSON sample retained; raw unchanged responses and bundle evidence are in ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/bongaigaon/.

qualification.admission: not presented as source integration or runtime admission

uncertainty: Bhunaksha is a real first-party cadastral-map service with successful anonymous district-to-parcel requests, but the sampled geometry is from one village part and the public response does not by itself prove complete citywide coverage or exact correspondence to the WUP point.
